steps.title: Create the orders source
statements: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground

CREATE TABLE sqltide_playground.playground_orders
(
    order_id UInt64,
    status String,
    total_cents Int64,
    _replay_partition Int32,
    _replay_offset Int64,
    _replay_timestamp DateTime64(3)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree()
ORDER BY (_replay_partition, _replay_offset)

steps.title: Publish the orders pipeline
statements: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_schema_versions (
    version UInt64,
    applied_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (version)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_object_state (
    state_id String,
    observation_id String,
    state_kind LowCardinality(String),
    deployment_id Nullable(String),
    logical_database_name Nullable(String),
    logical_object_type String,
    logical_object_name String,
    physical_database_name Nullable(String),
    physical_relation_name Nullable(String),
    logical_model_database Nullable(String),
    logical_model_name Nullable(String),
    is_selected_root Bool,
    object_fingerprint String,
    canonical_query Nullable(String),
    observed_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (state_kind, state_id, logical_object_type, logical_object_name)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_deployments (
    deployment_id String,
    workflow_fingerprint String,
    replay_lineage_mode String,
    boundary_time DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    created_at DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    tool_version String
) ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY (deployment_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sqltide_playground._sqltide_virtual_replay_boundaries (

    logical_view_name String,

ON anchor._replay_partition = cutoff_offsets._replay_partition
WHERE ((cutoff_offsets.cutoff_inclusive AND anchor._replay_offset <= cutoff_offsets.cutoff_offset) OR (NOT cutoff_offsets.cutoff_inclusive AND anchor._replay_offset < cutoff_offsets.cutoff_offset))
)
SELECT
  order_id::UInt64 AS order_id,
  status::String AS status,
  total_cents::Int64 AS total_cents,
  _replay_partition::Int32 AS _replay_partition,
  _replay_offset::Int64 AS _replay_offset
FROM filtered_replay_source
